name: Video Resolution Map
algorithm: Video Resolution Map — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method creates resolution maps for video deepfake detection:

1. **局部分辨率估计**: Effective spatial resolution is estimated locally using edge sharpness analysis, modulation transfer function (MTF) estimation, and texture detail measurements. This creates a per-region resolution map revealing where the image is effectively sharp vs. degraded.

2. **分辨率一致性Check**: Resolution across the frame should follow the camera's optical characteristics: uniform within the depth of field, decreasing with distance from the focal plane, potentially soft at frame corners (lens vignetting). The method checks for consistency. Deepfakes may show a face with different effective resolution than the background.

3. **分辨率边界检测**: The method detects boundaries between regions of different effective resolution. Abrupt resolution changes not corresponding to depth boundaries indicate compositing — where a generated face (at the generator's output resolution) meets original footage (at the camera's capture resolution).

4. **Upsampling/Downsampling检测**: The method detects evidence of resolution changes — interpolation artifacts from upsampling (ringing, aliasing) or detail loss from downsampling. These artifacts indicate the content has been resized, consistent with deepfake pipelines that generate at one resolution and resize to match the target video.

5. **时间分辨率稳定性**: Effective resolution should remain stable across frames for static content. The method tracks resolution maps over time — deepfake generation may produce temporally varying effective resolution as the generator's output detail fluctuates frame-to-frame.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through 视频 resolution map analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
